email.subject: Velvet Hair Studio's site is losing bookings
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I checked Velvet Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: it isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no tap-to-call button. Most people searching for a salon on their phone just want to tap and book — if they have to pinch-zoom and then hunt for your number, a lot of them leave and call someone else instead.

I also noticed no reviews are shown and the footer looks outdated, which can make visitors second-guess you.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
